B.name: Eliezer
B.line: Priest Ezra sent to Iddo (EZR 8:16), married a foreign wife (EZR 10:18, EZ 10:23)
family: descendant-of jeshua-3 (Jeshua, returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity (EZR 2:2, N)

disputed_verses.BHSA EZR 10:18: וַיִּמָּצֵא֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹשִׁ֖יבוּ נָשִׁ֣ים נָכְרִיֹּ֑ות מִבְּנֵי֙ יֵשׁ֤וּעַ בֶּן־יֹֽוצָדָק֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ וֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֔זֶר וְיָרִ֖יב וּגְדַלְיָֽה׃
disputed_verses.KJV EZR 10:18: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

first_reader_said: EZR 10:18: Both records hold Eliezer, priest of the sons of Jeshua, who had married a foreign wife in 10:18.

why: EZR 10:18 names Eliezer among the priests of Jeshua's family, while EZR 10:23 separately names Eliezer among the Levites in the same list, distinguishing two men. B conflates them: its EZR 10:18 citation and Jeshua family tie belong to A's priest. EZR 8:16 identifies Eliezer only as a chief man and does not establish which man he was.
